schedule_note: Cron '0 11 * * 1-5' UTC == 18:00 WIB (UTC+7), Mon-Fri, same calendar date in UTC and WIB. Mode is decided from the WIB weekday at runtime: Friday -> FULL, otherwise DAILY.

ingest.note: Row calendar = every weekday (matches history: 0 missing weekdays since 2023). Closed-market days carry the last level forward (history convention), bounded by max_carry_days. on_required_failure='na' (default): a required instrument with no usable value gets the text NA for that day (PARTIAL_SUCCESS, never SUCCESS), up to max_consecutive_na days in a row; 'block' writes no row so the gap is caught up when the source recovers. max_catchup_days = longest gap filled in one run (further limited by each source's history window).

JCI Index.definition: IHSG closing (IDX GetIndexSummary, IndexCode COMPOSITE). Same definition as Bloomberg JCI -> exact anchor check.

USDIDR BGN Curncy.definition: Yahoo IDR=X (USD/IDR) ADJUSTED close, delivered through a Google Sheet (apps_script/yahoo_feed.gs) as published CSV. UNVERIFIED live.

CO1 Comdty.definition: Yahoo BZ=F (Brent front-month) ADJUSTED close, delivered through a Google Sheet (apps_script/yahoo_feed.gs) as published CSV. UNVERIFIED live.

XAU Curncy.definition: Investing.com ID XAU/USD close. VERIFIED parse on saved page; return corr vs stored Bloomberg history 0.78 (n=19, mean |diff| 0.35%/day; Stooq measured 0.93 over 40d but is blocked from GitHub). Threshold 0.65 only detects a broken/wrong feed.

XW1 Comdty.definition: Investing.com ID Newcastle Coal Futures close (main) with the English page as fallback. VERIFIED parse on both saved pages; return corr vs stored history 0.996 and 17/19 days EXACTLY equal -> same series as Bloomberg XW1. Note: the most recent day is revised after first display (148.90 vs 149.35 seen on two saves), hence the settle lag.

KO1 Comdty.definition: MPOC daily 'Settlement Price RM' (BMD CPO futures; page keeps only the last ~10 pricing days). Parser VERIFIED on saved page; values match stored KO1 exactly on 4 of 10 days, but stored KO1 dates are inconsistent by up to 1 day vs MPOC (lag-0 return corr -0.03, lag-1 0.64, n<=9) -> definition check DISABLED (overlap too short); junction may carry one day of misalignment.

LMNIDS03 LME Comdty.definition: Westmetall LME Nickel cash-settlement. VERIFIED parse; return corr vs stored 0.70 (195d).

IBPRCPI Index.definition: PHEI INDOBeX Government CLEAN PRICE (daily; page shows 1 day only). Level scale differs from IBPRCPI (114.5 vs 118.6) but YTD change matches (-5.75% vs -5.80%) -> chain-linked on returns.

GTIDR1Y Govt.definition: Investing.com ID 1Y govt yield (%). UNVERIFIED live. Pipeline uses first difference for this series.
